verdict.rationale: Ashby documents AI that scans existing candidates, matches them against job criteria, and surfaces key signals for rediscovery (ashby-docs-1), which covers the core matching capability. The pack contains no vendor documentation of how the matching works or of safeguards on automated decisions. The only safeguard-related item is a hands-on report that the candidate opt-out form for AI resume processing never worked (ashby-comm-7), which weakens the safeguard side. Missing for 10: documentation of how the AI screening/matching model works, documented safeguards for automated decisions (human review, bias auditing, explainability), explicit application-screening evidence beyond rediscovery, and independent corroboration that matching works well.
